The Jaguar F-Pace R-Dynamic S stands as a benchmark of modern luxury performance, blending athletic design cues with everyday utility and reassuring factory backing. This certified model carries an exceptional factory warranty extending six years from new with unlimited miles, providing ultimate peace of mind. Finished in striking Fuji White and complemented by an elegant Light Oyster leather interior, this SUV commands attention on any road while enveloping its occupants in sophisticated comfort and state-of-the-art innovation.

Beneath the sculpted hood lies an advanced turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with a responsive automatic transmission and a sophisticated all-wheel-drive system. This powertrain delivers smooth acceleration and confident traction across diverse weather conditions, supported by selectable drive modes that adapt to your preferred driving style or road surface. Precision-tuned suspension components ensure an agile response through tight corners while maintaining a composed, smooth ride quality during long-distance highway cruising.

The exterior styling is highlighted by dynamic proportions, athletic lines, and impressive twenty-inch wheels that fill the wheel arches perfectly. Gloss accents and signature LED lighting create a commanding presence, while practical elements like the heated windshield ensure clear visibility during frosty morning departures. Every contour is crafted to reduce drag while accentuating the assertive stance characteristic of the R-Dynamic lineage.

Inside the cabin, Light Oyster leather upholstery creates an airy, refined atmosphere complemented by meticulously crafted trim details. The ergonomically designed seating offers multi-way power adjustments and heating functions to keep driver and passengers relaxed on journeys of any length. A panoramic glass roof floods the interior with natural light, while thoughtfully designed storage solutions and generous cargo capacity accommodate everything from daily commuting essentials to weekend luggage.

Cutting-edge technology is centered around a responsive touchscreen infotainment system featuring seamless smartphone integration, voice recognition, and crystal-clear audio playback. A comprehensive digital driver display puts vital performance metrics right in your line of sight. Advanced connectivity features ensure you stay in touch and entertained wherever your travels take you, while wireless device charging keeps your electronics powered up without cluttering the console.

Safety is paramount, featuring a suite of advanced driver assistance systems designed to protect occupants on every trip. Intelligent emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, lane-keeping assistance, and adaptive cruise control work harmoniously to monitor surroundings and mitigate potential hazards. Front and rear parking sensors alongside a surround-view camera system simplify tight maneuvers in crowded urban environments.

Convenience features elevate the daily driving experience, starting with keyless entry and a hands-free power liftgate that eases loading tasks when your hands are full. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains personalized cabin temperatures, while heated steering elements and remote start capabilities add an extra layer of luxury tailored to colder seasonal shifts.

        • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
        • Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
        Safety and Security
        • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
        • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
        • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe
        • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
        • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
        • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
        Technology and Telematics
        • Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
        • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

The 2026 Ford Bronco Big Bend represents a balanced approach to adventure—equipped with the technology and features to support your lifestyle without unnecessary complexity. The 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 SUV stands as a beacon of contemporary luxury and timeless design, its stunning Verde Silver Metallic exterior showcasing an exquisite balance of sophistication and modern style. Adorned with elegant 19-inch Multispoke Wheels, this SUV presents a confident and distinguished stance. The Piano Black Lacquer Center Console and Interior Chrome Package add refined contemporary accents, while the Multi-Color Ambient Lighting allows you to personalize the cabin's atmosphere. The Ventilated Front Seats, Power Front Seats with Memory, and Dual-Zone Climate Control provide exceptional comfort for both driver and passengers. The advanced 12.3-inch Digital Instrument Cluster and 12.3-inch Center Display showcase the intuitive MBUX Multimedia System, featuring Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and Wireless Charging. This 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 SUV is far more than just a luxury SUV, it is a remarkable expression of Mercedes-Benz engineering, innovative technology, and refined craftsmanship. With just 3,638 miles, its captivating Black exterior, luxurious AMG Black MB-Tex interior, and an exceptional selection of premium packages and options, this vehicle offers an outstanding opportunity to experience modern luxury and dynamic performance. Available at Mercedes-Benz of Palm Springs, this sophisticated SUV invites you to discover a driving experience defined by comfort, confidence, and unmistakable Mercedes-Benz prestige.

Power is sent through Porsche's all-wheel-drive system, and the vehicle is configured for brisk acceleration and steady road manners. The Turbo model sits near the top of the Cayenne range for this model year, with chassis tuning and drivetrain hardware intended to support a wider operating range than the standard trims. The available equipment list for this example includes a panoramic sunroof, and the body style provides the higher driving position and cargo flexibility expected of the model.

This 2020 Porsche Cayenne Turbo comes with leather seats, which bring a finished interior surface to the cabin. The seating position is set up for long-distance use, with the front row mounted low enough to preserve a sporting feel while still offering the visibility associated with an SUV. Cabin materials in this trim are typically selected with a higher level of fit and finish, and the leather upholstery is part of that presentation. The rear compartment offers space for passengers and their belongings, while the wide-opening doors and elevated roofline make entry and exit straightforward. Controls and switchgear are arranged in a driver-focused manner, consistent with Porsche's approach to the model.

This 2020 Porsche Cayenne Turbo is equipped with navigation, which integrates route guidance into the infotainment system. The center display is positioned for easy access from the driver's seat, and the control interface is intended to keep common functions within reach. Premium audio is also included, giving the cabin a more capable sound system than the base equipment. The overall electrical architecture supports the sort of connected and convenience features expected in a luxury SUV of this class, while the interface remains centered on the main touchscreen and its related inputs. The infotainment environment is part of the vehicle's daily usability, especially on longer trips where navigation and audio functions are used together.

This 2020 Porsche Cayenne Turbo includes collision warning, adding a driver-assistance feature to the vehicle's equipment list. The system is part of the broader active-safety suite and is designed to alert the driver when certain traffic situations require attention. The Cayenne Turbo also has sunroof(s), which add open-air capability to the cabin beyond the standard glass roof openings and contribute to the vehicle's light-filled interior feel. With the Turbo's performance hardware, all-wheel-drive traction, luxury cabin appointments, and the listed options working together, this SUV combines strong road performance with everyday utility and a well-specified feature set.

With a powerful 5.3L V8 engine, 10-speed automatic transmission, and rear-wheel drive, this three-row SUV combines performance with practical family hauling capacity. At 59,771 miles, this well-maintained Yukon is ready to provide years of dependable service.

- Perforated leather-appointed seating with heated and ventilated driver and front passenger seats
- Second row manual-folding bucket seats for flexible interior configuration
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Premium Bose 9-speaker stereo with SiriusXM and 360L satellite radio
- Automatic emergency braking, lane keep assist, and rear cross traffic alert
- Wireless charging and universal home remote
- Remote power liftgate with hands-free operation
- Four-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control and traction control
- 20-inch polished aluminum wheels
- Roof rack rails and vertical cargo net for additional storage versatility

This Yukon SLT is equipped to impress whether navigating city streets or heading out for weekend adventures. The comprehensive suite of safety features, advanced technology, and premium comfort appointments make this an exceptional choice for those seeking a full-size SUV that doesn't compromise on luxury or capability. Stop by today and experience the commanding comfort and confidence this Yukon delivers.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
